title: Four at once
goal: FA is a block: a whole full adder in one box, placed and wired like a gate. Chain four to add a3-a0, b3-b0 and cin: s3-s0 read the sum and cout the carry out, settled within 9 ns.
hint: each box hands its carry on to the next. Follow a carry from bit 0 up to bit 3, counting as you go.
